answer: Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. Reaching the signal of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, converted to a slow vesting stream. A glacier of per-task receipts records who did what, and the summit of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name.
